title: Fix broken video studio after model-layout PR
description: Default Seedance layout never renders the reference dropzone; generate can send invalid /uploads URLs and non-video model IDs. Restore a working generate path.
close_reason: Default ref dropzone restored, video-only model picker, server-side asset resolve.

title: Agent loop + project instructions (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md)
description: POST /api/coding/chat: stream or turn-based tool loop using Seed/Grok from live inventory. On session start, load AGENTS.md then CLAUDE.md from workspace root (Claude Code memory pattern, keep it small). Permission modes: plan (read-only tools), acceptEdits (auto file writes, still ask/timeout Bash), default (ask on write/bash). Stop when the model returns no tool calls.

title: Coding Studio UI: chat, file diffs, command output
description: New console view, new JS module (not more app.html). Folder picker, transcript with tool-call cards, list of files changed this turn, a command box that runs Bash in the workspace. Optional later: xterm PTY. Slash commands out of scope for v1 except /plan.

title: Coding workspace: attach folder and path jail
description: POST /api/coding/workspace with an absolute path. Store as session root. All file and exec paths must resolve inside that root (realpath, no .., no symlink escape). Honor .gitignore for listings. Reject missing dirs.

title: Coding tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash
description: Implement Claude Code-shaped tools, enforced by the harness not the prompt. Read/Glob/Grep: auto-ok inside workspace. Write/Edit: exact-string Edit like Claude Code (old_string/new_string), Write for new files. Bash: cwd=workspace, timeout, captured stdout/stderr — not a PTY. Deny paths outside root even if the model asks.

title: Coding Tool: Claude Code-inspired local agent
description: Local console service: attach a folder, chat with a tool-using agent that edits that tree, and run commands in that cwd. Inspired by Claude Code’s harness (workspace, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash, permission modes) — not a clone of the closed-source engine, MCP, subagents, or PTY. New src/coding/ package and a dedicated UI view; do not grow ui/app.html further.

title: Cache snapshot and POST /api/models/refresh
description: Persist last successful merge to a local JSON file (e.g. .cache/models_snapshot.json) so restart works offline. GET /api/models serves cache if fresh enough, else overlay-only static fallback. POST /api/models/refresh fetches both providers, writes snapshot, returns diff {added, removed, unchanged}. Never block generate on a failed refresh.

title: Settings: refresh models and show drift
description: Settings panel: last fetched time, Refresh button calling POST /api/models/refresh, list of added/removed IDs. Video Studio model menu reloads from GET /api/models after refresh. Do not dump the 24-model marketing catalog back into the UI.

title: Provider list-models clients (BytePlus + xAI)
description: Add src/providers/model_lists.py (or similar). BytePlus: GET {ARK_BASE_URL}/models with Bearer ARK_API_KEY (OpenAI-compatible). xAI: GET {XAI_BASE_URL}/models with Bearer XAI_API_KEY. Normalize to {id, owned_by, raw}. Do not use ListEndpoints (HMAC management API). Tests mock HTTP. Missing key skips that provider with a clear error, does not crash the app.

title: Classify live IDs and merge capability overlay
description: Keep a small local overlay keyed by exact id or prefix (seedance/dreamina-seedance, grok-imagine-video, seedream, seed-2, etc.) for ratios, durations, resolution, audio, draft, ui_layout_type, provider. Merge: live IDs win for existence; overlay fills capabilities; unknown IDs get conservative defaults and category=other (not in generate picker). /api/models returns merged catalog plus source=live|cache|static and fetched_at.

title: Live model inventory from BytePlus and xAI APIs
description: Stop treating MODEL_CATALOG as the live list. Fetch model IDs this API key can call from BytePlus ModelArk and xAI, merge with a local capability overlay (ratios, durations, modes), cache a snapshot, and let Settings refresh. Generate picker stays video-only.
